G3201.def:
μέμφομαι 
[in LXX: Sir.11:7 41:7, 2Ma.2:7 * ;] 
to blame, find fault: absol., Romains 9:19; with accusative, αὐτούς (WH, txt.; αὐτούς, Rec., WH, mg.; on rendering with αὐτούς see Westc., in l), Hébreux 8:8.†

G3202.def:
μεμψίμοιρος, -ον
(μέμφομαι, + μοῖρα, fate, lot), 
complaining of one's fate, querulous: Ju 16 †
